review_mode: Independent source and transitive-definition review; no reviewer builds or source edits

validation.note: Terminal status supplied by root; reviewed persisted log and exact final source.

findings: CreditAt indexes the actual pre-world, recipient and UInt256 amount as data. Here carries an actual FundingHistory.Trace before a literal increaseBalance; Next preserves the occurrence through an actual FundingHistory.Step. No desired recipient bound is an input.

CreditAt.prefix derives an actual funded prefix and prefixCredits+amount.toNat<=total by induction; nonnegative later deltas suffice. credit_at_fits then combines FundingHistory.balance_budget and the initial-plus-total ceiling.

genesis_budget combines the complete constructed genesis initial_funds_le, ledger_bound and numeric_envelope Counts; the 2^163<UInt256.size fact is kernel-decided. It does not assume a recipient no-wrap invariant.

BatchChecked and LedgerChecked annotations are constructed by induction, threading literal credit worlds and funding prefixes. Prop-valued proof indices do not encode unique operational histories; these annotations must not be inverted as unique chronology certificates.

The strengthened genesis_credit_at is the usable universal local consumer: any data-indexed CreditAt with the same constructed genesis, total and endpoint receives the checked-add guard. It does not require equality or uniqueness of proof terms, nor does it assert the numeric ledger and located funding history have the same internal chronology.
migration_add_fits obtains actual pre-world funds from the same ledger and checks the recipient after debit. It retains the source-funded premise and supports source/recipient aliases.
assumptions_and_limits: Counts for PoW/withdrawals/migrations, canonical genesis parser/state mapping, reference state representation and actual ledger classification remain external producers.

Every reference external credit must be connected to a CreditAt witness with matching before/recipient/amount and complete total/endpoint. Existence of an unrelated annotated ledger alone does not locate an actual reference operation.
Conserving transaction/SYSTEM/transfer internals are not classified as external credits by this result; their reference guards need their own adapters.
This proves arithmetic guards for literal pinned-world operations, not reference checked-U256 implementation equivalence or canonical chronological extraction.
